summary_en: Progress update on cost-of-capital and share-price-conscious management framework disclosed at institutional investor earnings briefing on 2026-06-01, including sustainability management initiatives.
title_en: Progress on Response to Realizing Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Share Price
translation_en_brief: WOOD ONE disclosed a progress update on its cost-of-capital and share-price-conscious management framework at an institutional investor earnings briefing held on 2026-06-01. The disclosure covers the company's response to implementing management practices that reflect awareness of capital costs and stock price dynamics, with explicit inclusion of sustainability management initiatives. Specific metrics, targets, or milestones are referenced as detailed in the attached materials but are not disclosed in the cover page excerpt provided.
